newsitem.title: NORWAY: Statfjord, Gullfaks output normal, loading patchy.
newsitem.headline: Statfjord, Gullfaks output normal, loading patchy.

text.p: Production at the North Sea Statfjord and Gullfaks oilfields was normal on Friday despite bad weather preventing a single tanker from loading at the Statfjord development, operator Den norske stats oljeselskap AS (Statoil) said.
The tanker at Statfjord had to disengage from the loading buoy at 1800 GMT Thursday. Statoil said it hoped to resume loadings late on Friday.
"Three or four tankers are heading out to the fields but are delayed by the weather," a spokeswoman said. "We hope to start loadings at both fields tonight."
North Sea loadings are often disrupted in the winter months due to high winds and swell. The maximium wave height for shuttle tankers to moor up to the offshore buoys is 4.5 metres.
